Who We Are

Built on Trust, Driven by Purpose.

Cornerstone Trucking isn’t just a logistics company — we’re the backbone of supply chains across the nation, delivering reliability with every load.

Our Story

A family business, run like one.

Cornerstone Trucking is a family-owned and operated trucking company that focuses on building strong business relationships. We believe in treating our drivers and customers with respect and integrity, and we communicate with our drivers regularly — because strong communication is the foundation of any relationship.

Every decision we make is filtered through one question: is this good for our people? That’s what a family business does.

What It Takes

Driver requirements.

We keep our requirements straightforward — if you meet them, we want to hear from you.

Required

Class A CDL

A valid Class A Commercial Driver’s License is the starting point for every Cornerstone driver.

Required

Doubles / Triples Endorsement

Our line-haul routes call for it — this endorsement is a must for the freight we run.

Preferred

1 Year of Experience

One year of driving experience within the last three years is preferred, not a dealbreaker. Talk to us.

Equipment & Support

Modern trucks, real support.

2022 & Newer Trucks

Freightliner and Volvo trucks with refrigerators, inverters, and Bluetooth-enabled radios.

Safety Technology

Dual-facing cameras and collision mitigation technology on every truck.

Experienced Management

Our team is promoted internally, with a combined 50+ years of on-the-road experience.

Services

Freight & Transportation Services.

A contract service provider for FedEx Ground, headquartered in Knoxville, TN — hauling line-haul freight hub to hub, safely and on time.

What We Do

Line-haul freight, done right.

Cornerstone Trucking is a dedicated FedEx Ground line-haul carrier, moving line-haul freight hub to hub and returning drivers home safely, every time.

FedEx Ground Line-Haul

Dedicated line-haul operations under contract with FedEx Ground.

Hub-to-Hub Transportation

Freight moves hub to hub, or via predetermined meets with other drivers.

Regional & Midwest Coverage

Primarily regional coverage, with consistent lanes across the Midwest.

Safety-Focused Fleet

Safety-oriented technology — dual-facing cameras and collision mitigation on every truck.

Areas We Cover

Serving Major Freight Markets Across The United States

Based in the Atlanta area, Cornerstone Trucking supports dedicated transportation operations across major freight corridors throughout the United States.

Legal

Privacy Policy & SMS Terms.

Privacy Policy

Information Collection

We may occasionally ask you to voluntarily supply personal information, such as your mailing address, email address, or telephone number, for purposes like corresponding with us or applying for a job. If you provide this information, we may use it to contact you via e-mail, text, call, or postal mail regarding our job opportunities, capabilities, and services. Users that receive this information via email or text will have the option to unsubscribe from this type of communication in accordance with legal requirements.

Automatic Collection and Cookies

Web users have the right to browse the Site anonymously. Cornerstone does not collect any of your personal information by simply browsing the Site. Like many other websites, the Site may use a standard technology called a “cookie” to collect information about how you use the Site. We have never and will never sell any of this data to third parties. Most web browsers automatically accept cookies, but you can change your browser settings to prevent that if you do not wish to store this information — note that this may prevent certain features of the Site from operating optimally.

Some web browsers incorporate a “Do Not Track” (DNT) signal. For lack of an industry consensus on what constitutes a DNT signal, Cornerstone does not currently take action to respond to DNT signals.

Disclosure of Personal Information

Except as set out in this Privacy Policy, we do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer your personal information to third parties. We may, however, disclose your personal information in the following limited circumstances:

  • We may share your personal information with service providers who help us with the operation of our business.
  • If and as necessary to protect the safety or security of the Site, to detect and prevent fraud or abusive behavior, or when otherwise required or permitted by law.
  • In the event that we sell, transfer, or otherwise dispose of the business to an affiliate, successor, assign, or other third-party entity.
  • With your consent.

Security

Cornerstone Trucking is fully committed to data security. No Internet transmission is ever fully secure or error-free, so we make no warranties as to the security of information submitted electronically — this is done at your own risk. However, we take precautions to help protect your personal information from unauthorized access, theft, alteration, loss, or misuse, and communicate our privacy guidelines to all employees.

The Site may provide links to other websites. These other websites are not under Cornerstone Trucking’s control, and this Privacy Policy does not apply to them. A link to a website does not mean Cornerstone endorses or accepts responsibility for its content.

Questions or Concerns

If you have questions or concerns about the information we maintain about you, or this Privacy Policy, please contact us at hr@cornerstonetrucking.com with “Privacy” in the subject line, or write to us at:

Cornerstone Trucking, Inc.
201 N. Weisgarber Road
Knoxville, TN 37919

SMS Consent: Your phone number and SMS consent will never be shared or sold to any third party or affiliates for marketing purposes.

Cornerstone Trucking reserves the right to change this Privacy Policy at any time, subject to applicable law. Updates will be posted on our Site with the date of the latest revision.

SMS Terms and Conditions

By opting in to receive SMS messages, you agree to the following:

1. Consent for SMS Communication

Phone numbers obtained during the SMS consent process will not be shared with third parties for marketing purposes.

2. Types of SMS Communications

  • Employment inquiries
  • Appointment / test reminders
  • Follow-up messages

3. Message Frequency & Fees

Message frequency may vary depending on the type of communication. Standard message and data rates may apply, depending on your carrier’s pricing plan.

4. Opt-In, Opt-Out & Help

We obtain consent verbally by asking: “Do you agree to receive text messages from Cornerstone Trucking? Reply STOP to opt-out; Reply HELP for support; Message & data rates may apply; Messaging frequency may vary.” You can opt out at any time by replying “STOP,” and get help by replying “HELP.”
